name: Battery
description: Battery energy storage device with capacity, operating limits, and runtime measurements.

topology.description: Connect to one or more single-phase or three-phase hybrid inverters and/or PCS devices across this group, with no product-level maximum.

P.name: Max Capacity
P.description: Manufacturer-specified usable energy for the configured battery system.

P.name: Nominal Voltage
P.description: Manufacturer-specified nominal DC voltage of the battery system.

P.name: Max Charge Current
P.description: Manufacturer-specified maximum continuous DC charging current for the battery system.

P.name: Max Discharge Current
P.description: Manufacturer-specified maximum continuous DC discharging current for the battery system.

P.name: Max Discharge Power
P.description: Manufacturer-specified maximum continuous DC discharge power for the battery system.

M.name: SOC
M.description: Remaining battery charge expressed as a percentage of capacity.

M.name: SOH
M.description: Battery state of health reported by the device as a percentage.

M.name: BMS Charge Current Limit
M.description: Maximum charging current currently permitted by the BMS.

M.name: BMS Discharge Current Limit
M.description: Maximum discharging current currently permitted by the BMS.

M.name: Avg Battery Temperature
M.description: Average battery temperature reported by the BMS for the battery system.

M.name: Max Battery Pack Temperature
M.description: Highest temperature among the reported battery pack temperatures.

M.name: Min Battery Pack Temperature
M.description: Lowest temperature among the reported battery pack temperatures.

M.name: Charge Discharge Status
M.description: Reported battery state: Idle, Charging, or Discharging.

enumData.label: Idle
enumData.description: The mapped battery status source reports an idle state with no active charging or discharging.

enumData.label: Charging
enumData.description: The mapped battery status source reports charging, with energy flowing into the battery.

enumData.label: Discharging
enumData.description: The mapped battery status source reports discharging, with energy flowing out of the battery.

M.name: Avg Cell Temperature
M.description: Mean of the reported battery cell temperatures.

M.name: Online Battery Pack Count
M.description: Number of battery packs reported online.

M.name: Start Stop Status
M.description: Reported operating state of the battery system: Stopped or Running. Map only when a confirmed read source exists; do not infer from current or power.

enumData.label: Stopped
enumData.description: The mapped status source reports that the device is stopped. Read this state from a confirmed status signal.

enumData.label: Running
enumData.description: The mapped status source reports that the device is running. Check power measurements separately to determine its actual output.

M.name: Battery Voltage
M.description: DC terminal voltage of the battery system.

M.name: Battery Current
M.description: Net DC current at the battery connection. Positive into the battery during charging; negative out of the battery during discharging. Normalize the source sign when mapping.

M.name: Battery Power
M.description: Net DC power at the battery connection. Positive into the battery during charging; negative out of the battery during discharging. Normalize the source sign when mapping.

M.name: Charge Energy
M.description: Cumulative energy charged into the battery. This counter is the input for periodic charge-energy calculations.

M.name: Discharge Energy
M.description: Cumulative energy discharged from the battery. This counter is the input for periodic discharge-energy calculations.

M.name: Max Cell Voltage
M.description: Highest voltage among the reported battery cells.

M.name: Min Cell Voltage
M.description: Lowest voltage among the reported battery cells.

M.name: Avg Cell Voltage
M.description: Mean voltage of the reported battery cells.

M.name: Cell Voltage Difference
M.description: Difference between the highest and lowest reported cell voltages.

M.name: Daily Charge Energy
M.description: Charge energy for the current day, calculated by the EMS from the change in M104 relative to its period baseline. Period starts at local midnight. Use the configured reporting time zone and the cumulative source unit (kWh). Requires a configured EMS period rule and a valid period-start baseline. If the baseline is missing or the source counter resets, keep the result unavailable until a valid baseline is established.

M.name: Daily Discharge Energy
M.description: Discharge energy for the current day, calculated by the EMS from the change in M105 relative to its period baseline. Period starts at local midnight. Use the configured reporting time zone and the cumulative source unit (kWh). Requires a configured EMS period rule and a valid period-start baseline. If the baseline is missing or the source counter resets, keep the result unavailable until a valid baseline is established.

M.name: Weekly Charge Energy
M.description: Charge energy for the current week, calculated by the EMS from the change in M104 relative to its period baseline. Period starts at the configured calendar-week boundary. Use the configured reporting time zone and the cumulative source unit (kWh). Requires a configured EMS period rule and a valid period-start baseline. If the baseline is missing or the source counter resets, keep the result unavailable until a valid baseline is established.

M.name: Weekly Discharge Energy
M.description: Discharge energy for the current week, calculated by the EMS from the change in M105 relative to its period baseline. Period starts at the configured calendar-week boundary. Use the configured reporting time zone and the cumulative source unit (kWh). Requires a configured EMS period rule and a valid period-start baseline. If the baseline is missing or the source counter resets, keep the result unavailable until a valid baseline is established.

M.name: Monthly Charge Energy
M.description: Charge energy for the current month, calculated by the EMS from the change in M104 relative to its period baseline. Period starts on the first day of the calendar month. Use the configured reporting time zone and the cumulative source unit (kWh). Requires a configured EMS period rule and a valid period-start baseline. If the baseline is missing or the source counter resets, keep the result unavailable until a valid baseline is established.

M.name: Monthly Discharge Energy
M.description: Discharge energy for the current month, calculated by the EMS from the change in M105 relative to its period baseline. Period starts on the first day of the calendar month. Use the configured reporting time zone and the cumulative source unit (kWh). Requires a configured EMS period rule and a valid period-start baseline. If the baseline is missing or the source counter resets, keep the result unavailable until a valid baseline is established.

M.name: Quarterly Charge Energy
M.description: Charge energy for the current quarter, calculated by the EMS from the change in M104 relative to its period baseline. Period starts on January 1, April 1, July 1, or October 1. Use the configured reporting time zone and the cumulative source unit (kWh). Requires a configured EMS period rule and a valid period-start baseline. If the baseline is missing or the source counter resets, keep the result unavailable until a valid baseline is established.

M.name: Quarterly Discharge Energy
M.description: Discharge energy for the current quarter, calculated by the EMS from the change in M105 relative to its period baseline. Period starts on January 1, April 1, July 1, or October 1. Use the configured reporting time zone and the cumulative source unit (kWh). Requires a configured EMS period rule and a valid period-start baseline. If the baseline is missing or the source counter resets, keep the result unavailable until a valid baseline is established.

M.name: Yearly Charge Energy
M.description: Charge energy for the current calendar year, calculated by the EMS from the change in M104 relative to its period baseline. Period starts on January 1. Use the configured reporting time zone and the cumulative source unit (kWh). Requires annual aggregation support and a valid year-start baseline. If the baseline is missing or the source counter resets, keep the result unavailable until a valid baseline is established.

M.name: Yearly Discharge Energy
M.description: Discharge energy for the current calendar year, calculated by the EMS from the change in M105 relative to its period baseline. Period starts on January 1. Use the configured reporting time zone and the cumulative source unit (kWh). Requires annual aggregation support and a valid year-start baseline. If the baseline is missing or the source counter resets, keep the result unavailable until a valid baseline is established.

A.name: Start

enumData.label: Start
enumData.description: Request the device to start through its configured control route. Confirm the outcome using the Start Stop Status measurement.

A.description: Request the battery system to start.

A.name: Stop

enumData.label: Stop
enumData.description: Request the device to stop through its configured control route. Confirm the outcome using the Start Stop Status measurement.

A.description: Request the battery system to stop.

A.name: Clear Error

enumData.label: Reset Fault
enumData.description: Request a fault reset through the configured control route. Check the device fault or alarm feedback to confirm the outcome.

A.description: Request a fault reset on the battery system.
